title: Tokens, the oft-overlooked appetizer: Large language models, the distributional hypothesis, and meaning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing LLM vocabularies to identify the explicit encoding of racial slurs (e.g., 'negro', 'coon', and subword variants of the N-word like 'igger') as standalone tokens.
Analyzing LLM vocabularies to identify the explicit encoding of gendered and sexual orientation slurs (e.g., 'bitch', 'slut') as individual tokens.

Cross-referencing token vocabulary lists from various language models (e.g., GPT-4o, Hugging Face models) against established 'bad word' lists (such as Google's banned words and Shutterstock's offensive words list) to quantify the proportion of profane and harmful tokens encoded by tokenization algorithms.
